## Summary

## Checklist

- [ ] Skill content is accurate for current CLI behavior
- [ ] New or updated skill includes valid frontmatter (`name`, `description`)
- [ ] `name` matches folder name
- [ ] Commands are copy-ready and do not expose secrets
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes locally

## Testing Notes

List how you validated the changes.
